title: Open TCG Trade Protocol — Game Definition
description: Schema every per-game definition file must validate against. See ../SPEC.md section 4 for the full narrative explanation. Intentionally does not set additionalProperties: false anywhere, so the format can grow without invalidating existing files (see SPEC.md section 4.6).

schemaVersion.description: Version of this meta-schema, not of the per-game definition file (see definitionVersion).

game.description: Stable lowercase identifier. Used to derive this game's BLE service UUID (SPEC.md 3.1) — changing it after publication changes the service UUID, which breaks discovery for anyone on an older definition file.

definitionVersion.description: Increment on any change. HARD RULE: an identifier already constructible under an older version must resolve identically under a newer one. Additive only — never redefine or reuse an already-assigned meaning.

canonicalSource.description: The authority this file defers to for what cards/sets exist. Disputes about correctness are resolved by checking here, not by discussion.

identifier.description: Card identity is represented as a plain JSON object keyed by these field names (SPEC.md 4.3) — there is no separate compact string encoding.

finishes.description: Closed vocabulary for physical finish. Not free text — a value not listed here is not a valid finish for this game.

knownCollisions.description: Documented cases where the non-variantKey identifier fields alone don't distinguish two or more real, distinct cards. Empty for most games most of the time — a registry of exceptions, not a general mechanism. See SPEC.md 4.5, including the three cross-referential rules this schema cannot enforce on its own.

case.description: Required normalization for string fields, applied before comparison, hashing, or display.

zeroPad.description: Display-only zero-padding width for integer fields. Never affects the numeric value or the canonical hash encoding (SPEC.md 5.2).

optional.description: If true, this field may be absent from a given card's identity object entirely (never present as null).

matchFields.description: The identifier field values shared by the colliding cards. Keys must be a subset of this game's identifier.fields names, excluding variantKey itself — enforced by a companion validation script, not by this schema (see SPEC.md 4.5).

description.description: Must state how a person can actually tell this variant apart physically — not just restate its name.

reference.description: Optional citation backing the claim — matters more here than elsewhere, since these are exactly the claims someone is likely to dispute.
